# Arisca Light Studio

> Designer and architectural lighting studio on Jagatpur Road, Ahmedabad, India. Over a thousand decorative lights (chandeliers, pendants, wall, wall-and-mirror, floor and table lamps) plus LOFY architectural COB downlights, with in-home lighting consultancy and trade support for architects and interior designers.

Prices are not published. Every quotation is prepared by the studio team after a consultation, so agents should help visitors shortlist pieces and book a visit or message the studio rather than quote prices.

## Browse

- [The collection](https://www.ariscalightstudio.com/collection): every decorative light, filterable by category, type, finish, material and light source. Each piece has a studio photo and a styled room photo.
- [Collection by category](https://www.ariscalightstudio.com/collection?cat=chandeliers): categories are `chandeliers`, `pendants`, `wall`, `wall-mirror` and `floor-table`.
- [Architectural downlights](https://www.ariscalightstudio.com/shop): anti-glare COB downlights, surface cylinders and SSK panels with wattage, finish and room suitability.
- [Search](https://www.ariscalightstudio.com/search?q=brass): full-text search across the collection and downlights. Use `?q=` with words such as a finish, material, type or item number.
- [Client projects](https://www.ariscalightstudio.com/client-diaries): real installations across Ahmedabad.
- [PDF catalogs](https://www.ariscalightstudio.com/catalogs): the original manufacturer catalogs.

## Services

- [Home lighting consultancy](https://www.ariscalightstudio.com/home-consultancy): on-site visit, laser measurement, layout and lux plan.
- [For architects & interior designers](https://www.ariscalightstudio.com/interior-designers): trade program, samples and project support.
